name: Fastlane Action
description: An action for executing fastlane lanes

lane.description: The lane that should be executed.

subdirectory.description: The relative path from the project root directory to the subdirectory where the fastlane folder is located.

verbose.description: If set to true, adds the verbose option to the fastlane command for extended log output.

options.description: The options that should be passed as arguments to the lane. The options should be serialized as a JSON object.

env.description: The env value that should be passed as an argument to the lane. The value should match to one of your fastlane env files.
